claims.claim: After about three days of moose sightings reported to Collingwood and The Blue Mountains OPP, a young bull was located Tuesday morning in Harbourview Park and tranquilized by Bear Wise staff in the Arboretum at about noon.
claims.episode_span: a young bull moose was located Tuesday morning in Harbourview Park and tranquilized by Bear Wise staff in the Arboretum at about noon
claims.source_title: Bull moose tranquilized in Collingwood, taken away in trailer
claims.supporting_quote: After three or so days of moose sightings reported to Collingwood and The Blue Mountains OPP, the young bull was located this morning in Harbourview Park and later tranquilized by staff from Bear Wise in the Arboretum at about noon.

claims.claim: The moose ran into the water by the bridge at Harbourview Park east of the Awen Gathering Circle and collapsed from the tranquilizer.
claims.episode_span: He ran into the water by the bridge at Harbourview Park, east of the Awen Gathering Circle, and collapsed from the dart.
claims.source_title: Bull moose tranquilized in Collingwood, taken away in trailer
claims.supporting_quote: The moose went running ending up in the water by the bridge at Harbourview Park east of the Awen Gathering Circle, where it collapsed from the tranquilizer dart.

claims.claim: Collingwood firefighters and OPP, including Insp. Loris Licharson, helped load the moose onto a plastic sled and winch it from the water into a trailer.
claims.episode_span: Collingwood firefighters and more officers, including detachment commander Insp. Loris Licharson, then loaded him on a plastic sled and used a winch to pull him up the bank into a trailer.
claims.source_title: Bull moose tranquilized in Collingwood, taken away in trailer
claims.supporting_quote: Collingwood firefighters arrived, and more OPP, including detachment commander Insp. Loris Licharson. The group loaded the moose onto a plastic sled and used a winch to pull the sled and moose from the water, up the bank and into a trailer.

claims.claim: Ontario Provincial Police named the moose Elliot.
claims.source_title: Elliot the moose captured after days on the loose in Collingwood
claims.supporting_quote: Ontario Provincial Police named him Elliot.

claims.claim: Bear Wise staff from Midhurst will take the moose to a location farther north.
claims.episode_span: Bear Wise staff, who came from Midhurst, will take him farther north.
claims.source_title: Bull moose tranquilized in Collingwood, taken away in trailer
claims.supporting_quote: The Bear Wise staff, who came from Midhurst this morning, will take the moose to a new home.

claims.claim: David Hawke confirmed the animal was a bull moose and said it had been spotted in Thornbury the day before.
claims.episode_span: Naturalist David Hawke, on scene with CollingwoodToday, confirmed it was a bull moose and said he had also been spotted in Thornbury the day before.
claims.source_title: Bull moose tranquilized in Collingwood, taken away in trailer
claims.supporting_quote: He confirmed it was a bull moose, and since it's rutting season, he was likely wandering in search of a mate. He'd been spotted in Thornbury yesterday as well.

claims.claim: Simcoe County will conduct a controlled burn on approximately 5 hectares at 793455 County Road 124 in Clearview, possibly in late September or early October, expected to finish in one day.
claims.episode_span: The County of Simcoe will conduct a controlled burn on about 5 hectares, or 12.5 acres, in the County Forest Nottawasaga Tract at 793455 County Road 124 in Clearview.
claims.source_title: County of Simcoe to conduct controlled burn in Clearview
claims.supporting_quote: The County of Simcoe will be conducting a controlled burn on approximately 5 hectares (12.5 acres) within the County Forest ‘Nottawasaga Tract’ located at 793455 County Road 124 in the Township of Clearview.

claims.claim: The controlled burn was delayed from spring 2026 because of weather and is meant to clear ice-storm debris so the forest can be replanted.
claims.episode_span: It may start as early as conditions allow in late September or early October, is expected to take one day, and was delayed from spring 2026 by weather.
claims.source_title: County of Simcoe to conduct controlled burn in Clearview
claims.supporting_quote: This controlled burn was originally planned to take place in the spring of 2026 but was delayed due to weather conditions.

claims.claim: Lands and Forests Consulting will conduct the burn; smoke should disperse northeast, east or southeast, and the county does not anticipate road closures.
claims.episode_span: Lands and Forests Consulting is contracted to run the burn.
claims.source_title: County of Simcoe to conduct controlled burn in Clearview
claims.supporting_quote: Lands and Forests Consulting (LFC), who provides highly trained and experienced personnel, has been contracted to conduct the burn, as they have done previously for Simcoe County Forestry.

claims.claim: A 32-year-old Collingwood man was arrested on September 20 and charged in connection with an armed robbery of a Circle K.
claims.episode_span: A 32-year-old Collingwood man was arrested on September 20.
claims.source_title: Collingwood man arrested for armed robbery of a Circle K

claims.supporting_quote: The County of Simcoe is pleased to announce that the nomination deadline for the 14th Annual Newcomer Recognition Awards has been extended to Friday, September 25, 2026.
